rows.label: tlk70000041_05_msg0001
rows.name:
Since we sent those supplies to
the militia, our policy towards
it has changed a bit, too.

rows.label: tlk70000041_05_msg0002
rows.name:
Now the king says we should
open the warehouse doors
to anyone in need.

rows.label: tlk70000041_05_msg0003
rows.name:
Let me know if the militia ever
runs short of food or medicine
or anything again, yeah?

rows.label: tlk70000041_05_msg0004
rows.name:
Ah! I was just being incredibly
serious about my work, wasn't I? Now
I'm suddenly exhausted...
